review.official:
Originally from
Rim Billiton
. Kroos also received her training from the
Columbian
Garrison at Holmegard with
Fang
and
Beagle
. She is calm and constantly smiling as she maintains a gentle demeanor. However, she sometimes breaks her facade, revealing a sharp-tongued, ferocious side.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.23u/L
Degree of infection is minor and physical symptoms are not yet present.

Kroos prefers put in the absolute minimum effort in life and on the battlefield, which is reflective of her weapon of choice - a modern crossbow. Despite her lazy work ethic, Kroos has become a skilled marksman and assists her fellow Operators by flanking the enemy and shooting them in the rear with deadly precision.

Ever since she was a child, Kroos lacked initiative. But during training, she showed an exceptional talent for marksmanship. On the battlefield, she effortlessly locates ideal sniper nests and rains down a hail of precise and deadly fire while backed up by her teammates. Both Fang and Beagle trust Kroos with their lives and she is their support sniper of choice.

While a member of the garrison, Kroos faced everything with a smile. Upon being infected with Oripathy and suffering discrimination, she had a complete change in mood. After angrily cursing out the other members of the garrison, she along with Fang and Beagle left the garrison for good. In order to find a way for the three of them to survive, Kroos searched far and wide before finally discovering their new home at Rhodes Island.

The always smiling Kroos often leaves others with an affectionate impression but does so in order to avoid trouble. She enjoys finding quiet places to slack off and take naps. Although she is typically well-mannered and aloof, when something she cares about is on the line her persona shifts into a more ferocious persona. Even when she is talking, she occasionally displays hints of that ferocity. This facade works on Fang, but not Beagle as Kroos cannot withstand her piercing gaze.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, it's such a nice day, so can't we take a little nap?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hmm...? We're about to leave? But I just got up... Wait, is this the Doctor's office? How'd I get here?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why am I always squinting? Because I don't want anyone to see my eyes. Nope, nobody~

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm really careless and get hurt a lot... But Hibiscus heals me every time, so I'm not afraid of getting injured. Oh gosh, that 'Curing Cuisine' of hers though, I'm terrified of it...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor! Someone left 10 alarm clocks by my bed! Who would do something so awful?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, let's play a game~ Put an apple on your head and we'll start~

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm always looking for fun things to do as a way to ease the pain of my Oripathy, I guess. Plus, I love seeing other people smile~

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: One day, our journey with Rhodes Island will come to an end, and hopefully we'll all get to have a warm, neverending dream, lying in the sunshine~ That's my number one dream~

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Can't believe the Doctor's a heavier sleeper than me...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi-hiii~ I'm Kroos~ I might be inexperienced, but I'll do the best I can~

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you so much!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion~ What a lovely dream~ Huh? I'm not dreaming?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Umm, where's the rally point?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huhhh~? Fang would make a better captain than me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Listen, everyone~! Stay calm~

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Why can't everyone try to get along...?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Sure!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let's take it slow~

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Mmhmm, I'm listening~

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I won't sleep on the job~

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: There you are!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Heeere I aaaaam!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Take aim!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew, that was tough...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I think we did alright!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm, I guess this was a bit of a letdown...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: S-sorry... I'll fight harder next time...!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I get my beauty sleep in here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ughh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hmm, have I matured?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor Happy New Year! I'm really sleepy already, so I'm just wishing you a good year ahead of time. How was that can I gave you, tasty? If you liked it, I could give you a few more.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor~ *Yawn*...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Fang! You're awful! Doctor, don't be scared, come with me. Hmm? What are you crouching for? There's no water bucket on the door. Pff, your chair's got all four legs too. No hot sauce in your cake either. Heheh, Doctor, Truth is, I haven't pulled a single prank at all! That's what I'm fooling them about!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's so fun having everyone together like this. Not a care in the land except what's coming up next and what eats there are. How nice it'll be if every day was like this. Oh, the light show's starting? Let's get moving, Doctor.
